blocks.text: Discuss how you would improve the MVP once it works: faster perceived latency, better reliability, and more efficient storage.

After the MVP ships, measure completion distributions, cancellation outcomes, retry duplication, and error recovery. Add resumable lifecycle streaming only when it improves freshness; never invent a percentage when the service exposes only queued or running.

Generation quality checks:
- Completion, cancellation, retry, and recovery outcomes drive optimization.
- Perceived progress remains honest when numeric progress is unavailable.
- Thumbnail and cache policies bound bandwidth, memory, and storage.
- Every uncertain command retains an idempotent recovery path.

blocks.title: Measured optimizations
items: Add retry with backoff for failures.
Use CDN with cache headers for images.

blocks.title: Generation failure and recovery
items: Large image payloads slowing the UI.

blocks.title: Scenario: slow, large, or uncertain generation

steps.title: 1. Slow generation
steps.text: Add versioned lifecycle events and show either trustworthy determinate progress or a clear indeterminate waiting state.

steps.title: 2. Large outputs
steps.text: Render a thumbnail first, then load full image.

steps.title: 3. Errors
steps.text: Keep the prompt, reuse an idempotency key when retrying an uncertain create response, and use a new explicit retry command only after a confirmed terminal failure.

items.label: Primary metric
items.helperText: Users feel the feature is fast.

blocks.title: MVP reliability invariant
blocks.text: Ship a simple, reliable MVP first. Then optimize perceived speed and reliability based on real metrics.

blocks.title: Failure modes
rows: Retry the same key and query the returned Location.
Use an indeterminate state and elapsed context.
Keep job metadata and provide retry or download recovery.
A broken preview does not erase output.
Hide protected output and reauthenticate before refetch.
Client cache is not an authorization boundary.

blocks.text: Prompt and option controls have persistent labels, errors link to the relevant control, and submission status is announced once. Progress exposes determinate values only when real and otherwise uses readable indeterminate text. Generated images have user-editable alternative text or an appropriate description workflow, while animation and skeleton motion respect reduced-motion settings.

Ship polling and a compact job history before optional streaming. Test lost responses, duplicate retries, cancel-complete races, long queues, unsafe output, image failures, auth expiry, mobile overflow, and reduced motion. Observe duplicate-job prevention, terminal convergence, cancellation outcome, and recovery.

blocks.title: Interview answer checkpoint
blocks.text: Before finishing, explain how AI Image Generation MVP (Two-Week Design) assigns client state ownership, preserves ordering, recovers from failure, measures performance, and manages keyboard focus.
